title: Spring Boot + Spring Data MongoDB Setup
last_note: AC1 PASS with real evidence: ran `mvnw spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev -Dspring-boot.run.arguments=--server.port=8087` against the already-running Docker mongodb container (host port 27018). Startup log shows 'Found 1 MongoDB repository interface', then 'Monitor thread successfully connected to server with description ServerDescription{address=localhost:27018, type=STANDALONE, state=CONNECTED, ok=true, ...}', then 'Started ReportServiceApplication in 5.096 seconds'. curl -i http://localhost:8087/actuator/health returned HTTP/1.1 200 with {"status":"UP"} (Mongo health indicator rolled into the aggregate status). AC2 (ReportRepository.findByReportedId) is structurally correct -- derived query method name matches Spring Data MongoDB's naming convention against the reportedId field, and Spring Data's repository scan picked it up at boot -- but cannot be functionally exercised yet since no REST endpoint exists to insert/query real documents (that's T052's scope, by this ticket's own explicit boundary). Not forcing a throwaway test to close this, per the project's no-piecemeal-test-retrofits convention.
